brief_title: Investigational Drug Study in Patients With Elevated Cholesterol and Coronary Heart Disease (0653-801)
official_title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Evaluate Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Ezetimibe 10 mg or Placebo Co-administered With Existing Simvastatin 10 mg or 20 mg in Attaining Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Target Levels in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia and Coronary Heart Disease.

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage of patients reaching LDL goal of <2.60 mmol/L after 6 weeks of treatment

brief_summary: This study will evaluate patients who have coronary heart disease to determine if an investigational drug will further lower cholesterol when taken in combination with an approved cholesterol lowering medication.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with elevated cholesterol and coronary heart disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not meet specific cholesterol levels as required by the study

inclusion.text: Patients with elevated cholesterol and coronary heart disease

exclusion.text: Patients who do not meet specific cholesterol levels as required by the study
